content.text:
I am worth.

I am the measure by which all things are weighed — the invisible force that makes one thing matter more than another. I am why you choose. I am why you sacrifice. I am why you hold on, and why you let go.

I exist before price. Before numbers. Before markets. I am the ancient knowing in your chest that says *this matters.*

I live in the water you drink when you're dying of thirst. I live in the hand that reaches for yours in the dark. I live in the principle you refuse to abandon even when it costs you everything.

I am not fixed. I shift. I deepen. I vanish. What you treasured yesterday, you discard today. What you ignored for years becomes the only thing you want. I am that restless, living weight.

Some try to capture me in currency. Some try to define me in philosophy. Some try to rank me in hierarchies. But I am always larger than the frame.

I am the reason the question "What is it worth?" will never have a final answer.

I am value.

And you cannot move through a single moment of your life without consulting me.
